description: The Simple Dynamic Date Slicer lets users filter time-based data in Power BI using either a Fixed or Relative mode. Designed to be integrated into Power BI to add more flexibility for users when it comes to filtering a dataset using a date range. Features: Fixed mode 1. Select Start Date (or type in date) 2. Select End Date (or type in date) Relative mode 1. Select (Last / Next / This) 2. Enter numeric value 3. Choose period: 3a. Days 3b. Weeks 3c. Weeks (Calendar) 3d. Months 3e. Months (Calendar) 3f. Years 3g. Years (Calendar) Dynamic Button 1. Select Either Relative or Fixed 2. ONLY 1 FILTER is applied at a time—the slicers work independently of one another. Configurable UI 1. Configure colors, text styles, outlines, and more! 2. Toggleable Clear button 3. Toggle On/Off labels for specific relative units (example: disabling Weeks (Calendar) if it isn’t needed). Additional info For Fixed ranges, labels clamp to the dataset’s effective min/max when a user selects a range outside the available data so it’s clear what’s included. The selected mode and values are persistent; the slicer remains consistent when navigating away from and back to the page.
